interpretation: In this frozen default-native1 configuration CPU-FFN1 lowers original GPU weight placement by75501568B, while all measured median throughput values are lower.
Prefill median drops41.29% and combined drops15.86%; observed ranges do not overlap. Decode median drops4.98%, with overlapping ranges. Three samples do not establish statistical significance.

The two independent dedicated-memory sampled peaks differ by-70475776B; this single sample per arm is not a guaranteed physical allocation saving or exact phase-boundary delta. RAM/commit observed peaks increase.
The default switch changes actual placement, domain crossings and cold resource admission. These observations do not isolate a CPU kernel, transfer, scheduler or Vulkan root cause.
Qwen2B fits this GPU. This experiment quantifies the default placement tradeoff; it does not assert mixed inference should beat full GPU or that native1 is an optimal CPU policy.
